## Design

### 2026-10-15 – # Piston Fidget Start

**3h**

# Piston Fidget Start
Once I thought of making a piston fidget (I had some other ideas before), I started to make the basic shape.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/91HF73JHUwEio9xtrq7tRJvOd8KiT0lT/def49e14e23d0afb4376e2a1523d2dcf8765548f29787f367a5551c2e8235da5.png)

# Twisting Base
I combined the two bodies an cut the intersect, I also made sure to add holes for where the bearings would be. I added tolerances to account for resin shrinkage too. I used the section analysis tool in fusion a lot too so I could see the inner structure/sizing easier.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/91HF73JHUwEio9xtrq7tRJvOd8KiT0lT/37af226a03685f9fb43d0f4b89944e9b4134e4cd6fb6490b6e4ae17fb7824e5b.png)

# Tidying up
I added fillets and nice rounded edges to the model I also added a round cap to sit atop the metal rod which will slide up and down. I added a appearance to each of the bodies,  main part/body in black resin and the metal rod in chrome.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/91HF73JHUwEio9xtrq7tRJvOd8KiT0lT/223794f7ed2e2d904188f15b955620c7622180c361d1092e32a1101ef7d343f1.png)

### 2026-10-15 – # Texture...

**2h**

# Texture...

I tried multiple time to do the texture around the base cylinder, but it was hard and i had to get the exact measurement for the circumference. I did multiple different attempts to deboss it around the cylinder face, with multiple sketches and different patterns, deciding about the best one.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/91HF73JHUwEio9xtrq7tRJvOd8KiT0lT/5ca206d3773fb3693cda9d4926a51640d4f5632c6a250b66954f48825752abb3.png)

*sketch attempt (not final one)

# Success!
I finally managed to do it and do it in this nice wavy pattern. I also added some concentric circles to the top of the piston rod header to act as grip. i decided to keep the main cylinder plain as a minimalistic design choice so the final result won't be too 'busy'.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/91HF73JHUwEio9xtrq7tRJvOd8KiT0lT/f8598a723cf142d57737d30843360041a61e1c3a00194eec32671791be914a32.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/91HF73JHUwEio9xtrq7tRJvOd8KiT0lT/4386494f52b65b98a1be73a0d2853842b2ae966b1fecd3d0fc12d41b9e941597.png)
